summary: Extends the Diameter Overload Indication Conveyance (DOIC) base solution from RFC 7683 with a new overload abatement algorithm. It lets an overloaded node set a maximum rate at which others may send it Diameter requests. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: A busy shop can tell customers to send at most so many orders per minute. This is how a Diameter server says its limit.
